summary: Quote mode across a dropped socket: the new socket logs in, authenticates on its first binary frame and registers again; what Motilal sent before the drop is not reported as current on the new connection.

notes: The web publishes every subscription from its packet stores every 500 ms (motilal_adapter.py _poll_market_data); web.json holds the poll after each push, the desktop sends a frame when a packet changes what a subscription reports.
The web keeps last_quotes across a reconnect (on_close clears nothing).

deviations.reason: The desktop sends the canonical last_quantity in every broker's Quote frames, with Motilal's own name ltq beside it carrying the same value (feed/dialect/names.rs: one canonical set and each web name beside it); Motilal's web Quote dict sends ltq only.

After the reconnect the web still publishes the day OHLC it received before the outage (MotilalWebSocket.on_close clears nothing), a pre-outage value promoted as current; the desktop starts the scrip afresh on the new connection and leaves OHLC out until Motilal sends the G packet again (lead decision 2026-11-09, as for Upstox).
